title: mmt-plugin scaffold --json result, schema_version 1
description: The result of scaffold --from-pcap (docs/design/cli.md, section 6). Paths are relative to the project (-C) when inside it (POSIX separators), absolute otherwise. With --dry-run, or when an output is in the way, nothing is written and the actions are would-*; an unchanged file is not rewritten.

skip_until.description: The --skip-until pattern, in lower-case hex, or null.

model.description: The model the label and the id come from (--model, default <project>/plugin.yaml), or <stdin>.

name.description: The registered name: the label upper-cased.

frames.description: The frames read: until --max-packets payloads were found, else all of them.

payloads.description: The payloads sliced, one packet test each.

skipped.description: The frames read that gave no payload, by reason.

no-match.description: The parent selector does not match.

empty.description: It matches, with an empty payload.

fragment.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 fragment: not reassembled.

malformed.description: A header below the payload is broken.

unsupported-link.description: A link type scaffold does not decode.

retransmission.description: Under tcp: a segment whose bytes its stream already gave.

gap.description: Under tcp: a segment after bytes the capture lacks (more than 64 waiting in its direction or 1024 in all directions, which gives its direction up until a new SYN, or still waiting when the capture ends).

skip-until.description: Under tcp: a segment whose bytes all come before the end of the --skip-until pattern in its direction.

header_length.description: The bytes proposed as fields: the shortest payload, at most 16.

constant.description: Every payload has the same value.

bit_offset.description: A bit field of the 1-byte field at offset: its first bit, from the most significant.

bit_width.description: A bit field's width in bits.

length_field.description: The field whose value is the payload length minus adjust in every payload, or null.

tests_dir.description: Where the packet tests go (--tests-dir, default <project>/tests).

sha256.description: The file as scaffold writes it.
